title: First footage of Iran's Government's proposed Defense Minister
text:
First footage of Iran's Government's proposed Defense Minister"

"TEHRAN — Oct 12,  Iran’s Parliament held a special session on Monday to hear the plans and review the background of the proposed Minister of Defense and Armed Forces Logistics. The minister-designate presented his record and outlined his program, after which several lawmakers raised their views and questions."

""
"------"

"The spokesman for the Parliament’s Presiding Board announced that the confidence vote for the proposed defense minister will be held next Sunday, October 18."

""
"The nominee is Mehrdad Akhlaghi, a senior Defense Ministry official and former head of the Aerospace Industries Organization. He has spent years working in Iran’s sensitive missile and aerospace sectors, largely away from the public eye."

"According to international reports, he has been associated with Iran’s ballistic missile program. His name has appeared on UN Security Council sanctions lists since 2007, and he was later sanctioned by the United States in 2020 and by the United Kingdom in 2023 over activities linked to Iran’s missile and nuclear programs."

"Before this session, no public images of Akhlaghi had been released, largely due to security considerations. His appearance in Parliament marked the first time his face was shown publicly. Prior to that, some news outlets and Telegram channels had circulated incorrect photos, mistakenly identifying him as Mansour Saleki, an individual with no connection to the nominee.
